overlaps.note: Three pages import history (companion apps, ChatGPT/Claude, other agents); Companions also has a "Bring your companion" section. One page, three sections.
Per-reply ceilings, spend limits and monthly budgets live on three pages. Limits move into Usage and costs; Usage reports stays (members see it).
Four read-mostly status pages. Health hosts the three thin ones as sections; Safety check-up stays and feeds Home.
Your mailboxes, the Google account, and her own mailbox. One "Email and calendar" tile (Google as its detail); her mailbox stays a chat-app tile, renamed "Her own email" in the tile caption only.
Three small reminder pages in You. One page with three sections; Calls from her links to it.
"This computer", "Computer use" (whose first heading is also "This computer") and "On this computer". Kept apart, adjacent, with distinct one-line leads.
iPhone Shortcuts (5 settings) becomes a section of Phone and notifications.
Both about sharing context between apps. One page.
Subscriptions are a kind of provider. One page "Providers and plans".
Kept apart (different jobs) but adjacent; the store links both.
Three things called a report. Kept (different audiences); leads say which is which.
